description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/children (#8137, ADR 0327): the
Träger row, the school IDs of the Träger, the school rows, the roster of
the Stichtagszahl rule, one page of names at People Directory, the school
class and group of the page's memberships and the group names of the
page's schools in one administrative transaction. Flat in the number of
schools and children. Not counted: the tenant binding of each shown
school's transaction, which writes the read to that school's access log,
at most one per row of the page.
